chunk_052.0x088d:
You've boarded the trike.
Where are we headed?
chunk_052.0x08cb: Let's go back and search HQ one more time.
chunk_052.0x094d: All right, we're heading to Queen Hospital.
chunk_052.0x0970:
Gillian, where are you going!
We've got to hurry to Queen Hospital!!
chunk_052.0x09af: It's too late to get cold feet now!
chunk_052.0x09d8:
Come on,
let's head for the SNATCHER stronghold!
chunk_052.0x0a07:
Gillian!
There's no time for that.
Let's go straight to Queen Hospital.
chunk_052.0x0a69:
It's too soon to give up!
There has to be a way out of this!
chunk_052.0x0a9e: What on earth are you going to do?
chunk_052.0x0ab7:
It's hopeless!
Gillian!
We didn't have long together, but...
chunk_052.0x0ae4:
Quiet!
There has to be a way!
chunk_052.0x0b03:
It's impossible.
We're doing 250 kph...
There's no way we'll survive!
chunk_052.0x0b4c:
Damn it!
We keep going faster and faster.
chunk_052.0x0b6b:
It won't stop!
I can't cope!
There's just no hope...!
chunk_052.0x0bb7: I'll do anything if it keeps me from dying!
chunk_052.0x0bfe:
No good!
The door's been rigged too—it won't open!
chunk_052.0x0c3e:
Besides, even if it opened, at this speed
your body would be torn to pieces!!
chunk_052.0x0c89: If I blast the lock with the Blaster, the door should open!
chunk_052.0x0cbe: Even if the door opens, jumping at this speed means certain death!!
chunk_052.0x0cf9:
Wrecking the door will only make things
more dangerous!!
chunk_052.0x0d2c:
Don't get any reckless ideas!
...That's like taking a blind leap off
a cliff!
chunk_052.0x0da1:
No good.
Above 80 kph the safety lock kicks in and
you can't take off.
chunk_052.0x0de6:
What!
Safety lock, my ass!
Who bolted that useless thing on here!
chunk_052.0x0e1b:
You can't release the safety lock without
the special tool!
chunk_052.0x0e4c: We don't have the tool, so it's impossible.
chunk_052.0x0e65:
Why the hell don't we keep that tool on board!
＠赤Idiot!
chunk_052.0x0e98:
Takes an idiot to call someone an idiot!
You're the ＠赤idiot, Gillian!
chunk_052.0x0ef3:
Oh no, Gillian's given up!
It's all over now—!!
chunk_052.0x0f2e:
Argh, what a nag you are!
Fine, I'll do it, I'll do it!!
chunk_052.0x0fcb: Oh, come on, give me a break!
chunk_052.0x0fef:
All right!
We're ramming the wall!
Metal, hold on!
chunk_052.0x101e:
All right!
We're ramming the wall again!
Here goes—!
chunk_052.0x105a:
No good!
We'll be torn apart before we stop!
chunk_052.0x1094:
All right!
We're plowing into the sand!
Hold on tight!
chunk_052.0x10c9:
All right!
We're plowing into the sand again!
Here goes—!
chunk_052.0x1116:
Sink or swim...
I'll try pressing this button!
chunk_052.0x1145:
The radio came on, Gillian!
What are you doing!
chunk_052.0x11d9:
Thrust is up 23%!
What are you gonna do now, Gillian!?
chunk_052.0x122d:
The A/C came on!
Cabin temperature rising...
24...25...26...
chunk_052.0x1278: The temperature's nice and comfortable now!
chunk_052.0x1291: Who cares about that right now!
chunk_052.0x12b7:
If I die,
I wonder how Jamie would feel...
chunk_052.0x12f7:
She'd cry, I bet...
But then she'd forget me soon enough...
chunk_052.0x132e:
And then she'd marry some other man.
And he might turn out to be a violent
lowlife bastard...
chunk_052.0x138f: And poor Jamie would hide from her husband, looking at my photo through her tears...
chunk_052.0x13dd:
I won't die!
There's no way in hell I'll die!!
chunk_052.0x13fa:
If this thing doesn't stop,
I'm gonna die, aren't I...
chunk_052.0x1437:
Every bone in my body will shatter...
Bet it'll hurt like hell...
chunk_052.0x146c:
No way—!
I absolutely don't wanna die—!
